title: Clerk testimonial wall
description: Left: a 32px heading, muted copy, a copyable agent pill and one featured quote under an outlined quote mark. Right: two columns of white post-style cards (13px text, small square avatar, name and handle) drifting slowly upward at different speeds over a faint dot grid, fading out at the top and bottom. One column on phones.
notes: the columns are a CSS marquee: they pause on hover and stand still with reduced motion
avatars are props (the demo uses initials on tinted tiles)
